decoderReference.name: mpg123-decoder
decoderReference.referenceConvention: Native-rate mpg123 Float32 output with Xing/LAME gapless handling enabled; no resampling, normalization, trimming or fades are added by this tool. This is a reference measurement, not a guarantee of browser-decoder sample alignment.

envelope.aggregation: Each bin combines whole 10 ms analysis windows; max window RMS and max sample peak are retained. Null dBFS means exact zero.

measurements.gainBasis: Attenuation only: maximum decoded sample peak and whole-recording RMS of the validated runtime pilot selection are technical ceilings, plus a -3 dBFS hard peak ceiling. Not perceived-loudness normalization, true-peak measurement, or a combined-mix listening judgement.
